completion.summary: The README documents acceptance evaluation: the operator-set policy, the three evaluator modes, an advisory example, what a control-plane host lets the policy require, the newest-record rule, the carried failure, and the host-evaluates/Engram-enforces boundary. It also documents bound criteria (`--bind`), explicit handoff and claim recovery, and the two-project dogfood line (Engram and TermAl). Kimi's draft was taken over unchanged on master, and every claim was checked against the code. Three Codex and Claude review rounds were run, and the last was clean. Landed as 11f6322 on origin/master; docs only, so no build was installed.
